paite: "Leitung ah mihing a ding in kidouna a-om kei maw? Anite kilohmi nite bang ahi kei a hia?
english: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?

paite: Limliap deih mahmah sikha bang in, aloh lamen kilohmi bang in.
english: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

paite: Huai bang in bangmah lou khate nei ding a bawl ka hi, huan kei a ding in zan chimhuaite seh ahi.
english: so am I made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

paite: Ka lup chiang in, chikchiang in ka thou dia? ka chi a; himahleh zan asawt hi; lehlam lehlam ah nisuah matan kilumlet in ka om hi.
english: When I lie down, I say, ‘When shall I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

paite: Ka sa than leh leivui khal in atuam a; ka vun kimat in apuakkham hi.
english: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

paite: Ka nite siamganmi khohthei sang in akinzaw a, lametna bei a zatbei ahi.
english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

paite: "Aw ka hinna huih ahi chih theigige in; ka mit in hoih amu nawn kei ding hi.
english: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye shall no more see good.

paite: Kei hon mu mit in ahon en thei nawnta kei ding a; ka tung ah na mitte a-om ding ua himahleh ka omta kei ding hi.
english: The eye of him who sees me shall see me no more. Your eyes shall be on me, but I shall not be.

paite: Meipi mangthang a-om nawn louh bang in, huchi in kuapeuh Sheol a paisuk ahong paitou nawnta kei uhi.
english: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. shall come up no more.

paite: A-inn ah akik nawn kei ding a, amun in amah athei nawn kei ding hi.
english: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.

paite: Huaiziak in ka kam ka khou kei ding a; ka lungsim gimna ah thu ka gen ding; haksatna ah ka kha ka phun ding hi.
english: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

paite: "Tuipi ka hi hia, ahihkeileh tua tuipi ngapi lian ka hi a hia, huchi a kei na hon chin nak?
english: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

paite: Ka lupna in hon lungmuan ding a, ka tutna nem in ka phunna azangkhaisak ding, ka chih chiang in.
english: When I say, ‘My bed shall comfort me. My couch shall ease my complaint;’

paite: Huai chiang in mang in na hon lausak a, mengmuhna in na hon mulkimsak hi.
english: then you scare me with dreams, and terrify me through visions:

paite: Huchi in ka kha in heklup leh sihna atel a, hiai ka guhte sang in.
english: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.

paite: Ka hinna ka chimtak a; ka hing gige kei ding, hon omsak maimai un; ka nite lah bangmah lou ahi ngal a.
english: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

paite: "Mihing bang ahia, hichi tel a na pahtawi ding a, amah tung a na lungtang na koih ding?
english: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

paite: Zingsang teng a amah na veh a, mitphiat kal chih a amah na ettel ding?
english: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

paite: Bang tan vei kei hon lehngatsan lou ding na hia, bang tan vei ka chil ka nawmvalh matan hon omsak maimai lou ding na hia?
english: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

paite: Na khial hi taleng, na tung ah bang ka hih a, Aw mite chingpa nangmah? Bangziak a nang a dia chiamtehna bang a hon koih na hia, huchi a keimah a dia puakgik ka hih maimah?
english: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

paite: Bangziak a ka tatlekna ngaidam lou a, ka thulimlouhna lamang lou oi? Kei tu in leivui a lum ding ka hi a; kuhkaltak in na hon zong dia, himahleh ka omta kei ding hi."
english: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now shall I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I shall not be.”
